questions: How many devices did you measure under rf, and how many showed the doubled first step? The text names JJ6, JJ7 and JJ8 and gaps "ranging from 20 to 120 nm in different devices" (p. 2); the Shapiro data come from JJ8.
Why were the others set aside?

Which ranges of field (magnitude and direction), rf frequency, rf power and temperature did you measure beyond the ones shown, and over how many cooldowns? For example, why Vrf between 3 and 6 mV for Fig. 3 (right)?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like?

What does the dc V(I) of JJ8 at B = 2.2 T look like without rf, on the microvolt scale: does the switching jump span 0 to 6 µV, and does the return of the 6 µV step above Vrf = 10 mV coincide with that jump softening?
Did you measure Shapiro steps at 2 or 4 GHz above 2 T, and does the first step stay missing there?
What transparency do you extract from the excess current in Fig. 2, at zero field and above 2 T, and do junctions with other gap widths show the same doubling?
Did you apply field along the spin-orbit field (perpendicular to the current), where your model expects no topological phase, and if so, is the 6 µV step present there above 2 T?
